messages:
Priya K.: Morning all, I'm setting up a company loaner MacBook Air (M2). At the MDM enroll step it asked to enable FileVault but then said 'Escrow failed: network unreachable'. I'm on home wifi with VPN off. Any tips?
IT Help: Hi Priya, welcome! That message usually means the device couldn't reach our escrow endpoint during the first-time key upload. Can you check date/time and run `ping escrow.redwood.ai`? Also which macOS version?
Priya K.: macOS 13.6.1. Ping fails: 'ping: cannot resolve escrow.redwood.ai'. DNS maybe? I can tether to my phone if needed.
DevEx Omar: If DNS is flaky on home networks, tethering often works. Also try clearing /etc/resolv.conf or set 1.1.1.1 as a test DNS. The enrollment is sensitive to captive portals too.
mdm-bot: Enrollment logged for serial C02XYZ98765 by priya@redwood.ai  policy=filevault-escrow (ticket MDM-2026-899).
IT Help: We can also provide a temporary offline escrow token. PMing you a one-time code that you can paste into the MDM client to complete enrollment without contacting escrow.redwood.ai directly.
Priya K.: Got the token and entered it. It shows 'Escrow token accepted' and FileVault started encrypting. Thanks! Quick Q: will the token expire?
Security Lina: Token expires in 4 hours and is single-use. We rotate them for security. We'll remove the ticket after verifying the escrow ID in our console.
Priya K.: FileVault finished. One more: I'd like to install Homebrew and a few dev deps. Do I need admin after enrollment?
IT Help: Post-enrollment you should be standard user; we temporarily grant an admin elevator if you need to install system packages. Request via this channel or open a ticket; we typically allow 2 hours for new hires.
DevEx Omar: For common dev tools, we have a bootstrap script that uses `sudo -v` once while the admin window is open. Ping me and I'll run it with you so you don't hit repeated sudo prompts.
Priya K.: Perfect, thanks all!
